text: 锐方（上海）私募基金管理有限公司发布自购公告称，基于对中国资本市场长期稳健发展的看好，以及对团队主动管理能力的信心，锐方基金及核心成员将于本公告发布之日起两周内，以自有资金5亿元申购公司旗下产品。 这笔5亿元的自购，不仅远超年内单家私募自购的普遍水平，也有望刷新近年私募行业单笔自购的规模纪录。（中国基金报）
text_en: Ruifang (Shanghai) Private Fund Management Co., Ltd. issued a self-purchase announcement stating that based on optimism about the long-term steady development of China's capital market and confidence in the team's active management capability, Ruifang Fund and its core members will use 500 million yuan of their own funds to subscribe to the company's products within two weeks from the date of this announcement. This 500 million yuan self-purchase not only far exceeds the general level of self-purchases by a single private fund during the year, but is also expected to set a record for the scale of a single self-purchase in the private fund industry in recent years. (China Fund News)
